in_sanskrit.name: Sams
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Sun, Light, Power
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sams एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Sams is derived from the Sanskrit word Samas, which means equal or balanced. It is a name that signifies the power of the sun and represents light, energy, and strength. In Hindu mythology, the sun god is believed to provide life and energy to all living beings.
